# Amplify Outreach

Amplify Outreach is a Meta ads agency for home service business owners.

Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/amplifyoutreachmarketing/

## Core Offer

- Month-to-month Meta ads management
- Campaign scope and investment confirmed after the free lead-flow audit
- As many campaigns as the business can responsibly run
- Ad spend remains separate and controlled by the client

## Positioning

Amplify Outreach builds Facebook and Instagram advertising services that bring quality leads and real revenue. Success is not measured by clicks alone. The main scorecard is qualified leads, booked estimates, closed work, and revenue from campaign opportunities.

## Primary CTA

The primary conversion action is a free lead-flow audit. The audit should identify the first campaign angle, lead-quality filters, break-even math, scorecard notes, and campaign tracking gaps.

## Industries

- Landscaping and hardscaping
- Lawn care
- Hardscaping
- Exterior cleaning
- Pressure washing
- Roof washing and soft washing
- Commercial exterior cleaning
- Junk removal
- Estate cleanouts

## FAQ Summary

Campaign management covers Meta strategy, setup, testing, tracking, optimization, and reporting. Scope and investment are confirmed after the free lead-flow audit. Ad spend is separate and should stay in the owner's ad account. The service is month to month. Campaign count depends on service lines, budget, seasonality, capacity, and the quality of the tracking path.

## Launch Notes

The phone number, business email, form delivery configuration, production-domain routing, and verified Google Business Profile access still need to be connected before launch.
